title: Phase 4 transition request, result, owner approval, assured gate decisions and story completion
description: Runtime uses stdlib closed validation. evaluate is candidate evidence; consume authenticates a completed run. A passing readiness candidate binds its 15 gate identities. Only fresh authenticated consumption derives the ordered G-HIGH-RISK, G-READINESS and READY records. Missing owner bindings reject. Approval request_sha256 excludes approvals to permit posting references after approval. No caller-provided command is accepted. A gate decision reports one authenticated consumption for G-OQ8 governing-design availability or G-TENANT canonical tenant qualification; saved decisions are never authority for later consumption. Release/promotion use the fixed publication-authority-v1 adapter, requiring exact record, sole profile, independent composing coverage and owner codec inputs; unavailable fixed prerequisites refuse.

head_sha.description: For AD-26, the issuance head authenticated with its traceability digest; otherwise the exact attempt head.

request_sha256.description: For file subjects, canonical request without approvals. For AD-26, canonical repository/transition/subject_sha256/required_level; outside-subject edits preserve ratification.

command_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the owning validator command or lane identity as exact UTF-8.

subject_sha256.description: Subject digest authenticated by the owning validator.

evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical owner evidence identity. The enrolled gate decisions bind binding, predecessors and seal. G-OQ8 additionally binds availability with the run ID, attempt, head, repository, workflow digest and IDs of both successful jobs.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical passing owner decision, reproduced on every use.

approvals_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical applicable approval records authenticated by the owning validator.

baseline_tree.description: Git root tree of the approved baseline at head_sha. G-BASELINE authenticates approval of the baseline.

verifier_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON path-to-SHA-256 map for the fixed transition and readiness CONTROL_FILES inventories.

readiness_request.description: Exact main source tree, dedicated readiness workflow and verifier, and one owner-evidence identity for each of the 15 prerequisite gates. Gate keys are unique. Derived decisions enter only the consumed result.

readiness_artifact_input.description: A standard-control owner can authenticate an exact approved artifact without a CI attempt.
